## About
ProAm Auto Accessories started as an extension of the owner's passion for performance cars and club racing. The idea was simple: bring world class products for sports cars, European sedans and American muscle cars to Houston area enthusiasts. ProAm was one of the very first distributors in the USA for brands like Recaro, PIAA, Koni, Redline, Momo, Corbeau and Simpson.
We're in the Galleria Area on Richmond Avenue, the stretch locals call "the Richmond strip." Our place has a warehouse, a showroom and installation bays, so we don't just sell parts. We put them on, and we handle maintenance and repair too. And it's a good spot to hang out with fellow enthusiasts.
Our website has taken that local reputation to customers all over, but the service is the same whether you call, email, order online or walk into the showroom. Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 66 Google reviews. If you don't see what you need, call us and we'll do our best to help.

## Services
- Full synthetic oils: We use only full synthetic Royal Purple, Red Line or Amsoil products.
- Shocks, struts, springs and bushings: Replacement of worn shocks, struts, springs and bushings.
- Big brake kit installation: Installation and set-up of big brake kits and coil over suspension.
- Tirerack.com preferred installer: Bought from Tirerack.com? We're a Preferred Installer for their purchasers.
- Fender rolling: Fender rolling to clear big wheel and tire packages.
- Corner weight balancing: Done with digital scales, with or without turnplates.
- Classic and muscle car service: Service work for classic and muscle cars.
- Exhaust and intake upgrades: Performance exhaust and intake installs.
- Detailing: Clay-bar paint rejuvenation, leather cleaning and treatment, and wheel detailing.

## FAQ
Q: Are you a Tirerack.com Preferred Installer?
A: Yes. We're a Preferred Installer for Tirerack.com purchasers.

Q: What if I can't find the part I need on your website?
A: Give us a call or send us the details through our email form. We'll do our best to track it down for you.

Q: Do you price match?
A: If you find a lower delivered price on the identical product from a competitor, let us know and we'll try to match it. Auction sites, rebates, liquidations and membership club stores don't qualify.
